answer:
**Argentina** won the 2022 FIFA World Cup.

In the final, Argentina drew 3–3 with France after normal and extra time (Messi and Mbappé each scoring hat-trick-caliber performances), with Argentina winning on penalties and recorded as the match winner in the data. Argentina's run to the title included beating Netherlands (2–2, won on penalties) in the quarter-final and Croatia 3–0 in the semi-final, before edging France in the final — per `world_cup.world_cup.matches` and `world_cup.world_cup.tournaments`.
